reviews.summary: Asked to fix the croissant sample line, which had the pastries coming from the sender's city (contradicting the post's own advice to order perishables near her), and the takeaway that said all perfume is banned from US international mail rather than perfume containing alcohol.

Takeaway overstated the USPS rule (perfume with alcohol, not all perfume) in both languages; the Christmas post link promised 'dates for each way of sending', which that post doesn't give; Halfway's Spanish note read as an order to the reader; several Spanish calques ('tomar prestadas', 'alrededor de', 'una foto de ella'); 'Bring a towel and the good mood' unidiomatic; 'Build it' with no antecedent in the Bouquet note.
Two variant People-also-ask questions unanswered: 'How to care for a long distance girlfriend?' and 'What do Gen Z girls like as gifts?'. Polish: 'the post can't carry' reads ambiguously.
